REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D
Date ____ / ____
Date March 28, 1935

Subject (in full) Enquiries regarding whereabouts of Li Ying-feng
(李应丰)

Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by A. Griffith A.I.

Discreet enquiries made at 12 Chusan Road go to
show that this address is occupied by the Dah Tsung (大衆出版部)
Publication Society, and that Li Ying-feng worked there as
an editor until about two months ago, when he resigned.
Since then he has not been seen by his former fellow workers.
The inmates of this Society could throw no light
upon his present whereabouts and even were not in a position
to transmit any mail matter to him.

Sih Tse liang
D. I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

档案号 S. B. 登记处。
编号 D
日期 ____ / ____
日期 1935年3月28日

事由（全称） 关于李应丰下落之查询

由 侦探员 施子良 制作 经由 助理督察 A. Griffith 转呈

在中山路12号进行的秘密查询显示，该地址由大衆出版部占据，李应丰曾在此担任编辑，直至约两个月前辞职。此后，其前同事再未见过他。该社成员对其当前下落一无所知，甚至无法向其转交任何邮件。

施子良
侦探员

副督察（特别科）。
